correctness.rationale: The explicit id-3/id-24 edge lists independently reconstruct as connected 3-regular bipartite graphs, are non-isomorphic, and have exactly the shared stated characteristic polynomial. Completeness is correctly stated as conditional on the published count A006823(9)=149 rather than claimed from the random generator alone.
